rules.h: Log every conversation the same day, not on Monday.
rules.p: By Monday the names blur and the context is gone.

rules.h: Set the next meeting while you are standing there.
rules.p: "Can I get thirty minutes with you and one of our team leaders next week?" converts far better than a follow-up message three days later.
If an agent raises eXp sponsor or revenue share, hand it to Justin or the relevant team leader. That conversation is not yours, and staying out of it protects you.

weeks.label: Week 1
intro: Two days. Get trained, then get on the phone.

notes: The training block is the most valuable two hours of your month. Record it if Justin is willing. Write the exact language for each of the four motions — what he opens with, what he says when they hesitate, how he asks for the meeting. You are building the script library that does not exist.

blocks.task: Two-hour training block with Justin — recruiting, VIP tickets, The Edge, The Forum
blocks.outcome: Four scripts written in Justin's actual words, not paraphrased

blocks.task: Build your call list: every Forum member, plus Justin's recruiting names
blocks.outcome: A named list you can dial from tomorrow

blocks.task: Start Forum member introductions and registration reminders

notes: Report the misses yourself. If you set three instead of five, say three and say what you learned about why. Numbers reported honestly in week one buy you enormous credibility for week four.

blocks.task: Finish Forum member introductions and registration reminders
Hold or confirm your booked recruiting appointments
Log everything in GHL with true lead sources
Week one numbers to Connor and Justin
blocks.outcome: Reported against the scoreboard, including misses

notes: One task, and it is worth the hour: build your eXpcon target list. Names of agents you want to find at the Salt Palace next week — who they are, what team, why they might move. Aim for 25. Bring it to Monday's huddle.

blocks.outcome: Aim for 25. Bring it to Monday's huddle.

weeks.label: Week 2
weeks.subtitle: eXpcon week
intro: eXpcon 2026 runs October 7 to 9 at the Salt Palace Convention Center in Salt Lake City, with Gary Vaynerchuk giving the opening keynote. Thousands of eXp agents, three days, in your city.
This is the highest-leverage week of your first quarter and it happens in week two. Treat Monday and Tuesday as preparation for it, not as ordinary days.

blocks.task: Huddle. Walk your 25-name target list with Justin
blocks.outcome: Justin adds names and flags who he knows

blocks.task: Research the list: current team, production, tenure, why they might move
blocks.outcome: One line of context per name

blocks.task: Rehearse the conference opener with Justin — 30 seconds, not a pitch
Recruiting dials. Book anything you can before the conference
Forum and Edge follow-up from last week's outreach

notes: Get your badge situation confirmed today. You are not yet licensed or affiliated with eXp, so check with Justin what credential you need to be in the building and in the rooms that matter.

blocks.task: Build your three-day conference plan with Justin: which sessions, which parties, where he will introduce you
Confirm your registration, badge and any ticket requirements
Set up a fast capture method — one note per conversation, name, context, next step
blocks.outcome: Something you can use standing up

blocks.task: Keynote, then the floor. Stay with Justin — his introductions are worth more than any approach you make cold
Work your target list deliberately. Sessions where your named agents will be
Close-out day. Chase the names you have not found. Confirm every appointment in writing before you leave the building
blocks.outcome: 5 set for the week. Every conversation logged same day

intro: Two jobs this week. Convert the conference, and hit the VIP guest numbers.
outro: By Friday the Axcion Recruiting tab should be live. Once it is, your daily and weekly recruiting accountability moves there. Ask Connor to walk you through it rather than working it out alone.

blocks.task: Huddle. Rank every conference conversation: hot, warm, no
Call every hot name from eXpcon. Three days is the outer edge of warm
Hold recruiting appointments carried over from Friday

blocks.outcome: Conference converted or honestly written off

blocks.task: Referral VIP guest push. Work the Forum member list for referrals — members refer the best guests
Ad VIP guest follow-up — these are colder, so expect more attempts per registration
Script library review with Justin. What is working, what is not

notes: By Friday the Axcion Recruiting tab should be live. Once it is, your daily and weekly recruiting accountability moves there. Ask Connor to walk you through it rather than working it out alone.

blocks.outcome: Every record current and correctly sourced

blocks.task: Week numbers to Connor and Justin

weeks.label: Week 4
intro: First week with no event and no deadline cluster. This is what the job actually looks like, and it is the week that tells us whether the rhythm holds.
The shape repeats daily: recruiting in the mornings, Forum and Edge in the afternoons. Recruiting goes first because it loses every time it goes second.
outro: Two things to build this week, both yours to own.

The objection playbook. You have been on enough calls now to know the five objections you actually hear — on the $25,000 Forum decision and on the recruiting conversation. Write your answer to each. Ninety minutes, once, on Thursday.
The ideal profile. One page on who the right Forum member looks like and who the right recruit looks like. This is what stops you spending a week on people who were never going to say yes.

If the mornings are slipping, say so at Thursday's debrief rather than at the month-end review. A blocked calendar that quietly erodes is the most common way this role goes wrong, and it is fixable the week it starts.

blocks.task: Recruiting dials from the Axcion list

blocks.outcome: Every open opportunity has a next step and a date

blocks.task: Edge outreach — the accounts Justin hands you

blocks.outcome: Nothing in the queue older than 24 hours

blocks.task: Referral asks to existing Forum members
blocks.outcome: Named referrals, not "I'll think about it"
